readings: Using only player_award_vote joined to player on player_id, and excluding players with a missing death country (alive players), compute the average points_won (ignoring NULL points) for each death country. Show each death country, its average, and the signed difference (country average minus the simple average of the per-country averages), unrounded.

Using only player_award_vote joined to player on player_id, and excluding players with a missing death country (alive players), compute the average points_won (ignoring NULL points) for each death country. Show each death country, its average, and the absolute difference between it and the simple average of the per-country averages, unrounded.

Using only player_award_vote joined to player on player_id, compute the average points_won (ignoring NULL points) for each death country. Players with a missing death country form their own group, which counts as one of the per-country averages. Show each group, its average, and the signed difference (group average minus the simple average of all group averages including the missing-country group), unrounded.

Using only player_award_vote joined to player on player_id, compute the average points_won (ignoring NULL points) for each death country. Players with a missing death country form their own group, which counts as one of the per-country averages. Show each group, its average, and the absolute difference between it and the simple average of all group averages including the missing-country group, unrounded.
queries:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT p.death_country AS death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points
  FROM player_award_vote v
  JOIN player p ON v.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT death_country, avg_points, avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM c) AS diff
FROM c;
WITH c AS (
  SELECT p.death_country AS death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points
  FROM player_award_vote v
  JOIN player p ON v.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT death_country, avg_points, ABS(avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM c)) AS abs_diff
FROM c;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT p.death_country AS death_country, AVG(pav.points_won) AS avg_points
  FROM player_award_vote pav
  JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT death_country, avg_points,
       avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM g) AS diff_from_avg
FROM g;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT p.death_country AS death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points
  FROM player_award_vote v
  JOIN player p ON v.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT death_country, avg_points,
       ABS(avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM g)) AS abs_diff
FROM g;
